MERGE INTO MST_TRADE_CALENDAR RPI USING (
SELECT #{item.tradeCalendarId,jdbcType=CHAR} TRADE_CALENDAR_ID, #{item.calendarId,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CALENDAR_ID, #{item.createUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_USER, #{item.createDept,jdbcType=VARCHAR} CREATE_DEPT, #{item.createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} CREATE_TIME, #{item.updateUser,jdbcType=VARCHAR} UPDATE_USER, #{item.updateTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} UPDATE_TIME FROM dual
) TEMP
ON( RPI.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID = TEMP.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET RPI.CALENDAR_ID = TEMP.CALENDAR_ID, RPI.CREATE_USER = TEMP.CREATE_USER, RPI.CREATE_DEPT = TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, RPI.CREATE_TIME = TEMP.CREATE_TIME, RPI.UPDATE_USER = TEMP.UPDATE_USER, RPI.UPDATE_TIME = TEMP.UPDATE_TIME
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( TRADE_CALENDAR_ID, CALENDAR_ID, CREATE_USER, CREATE_DEPT, CREATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME ) VALUES ( TEMP.TRADE_CALENDAR_ID, TEMP.CALENDAR_ID, TEMP.CREATE_USER, TEMP.CREATE_DEPT, TEMP.CREATE_TIME, TEMP.UPDATE_USER, TEMP.UPDATE_TIME )
